title: Finite Kummer level of the Tate twist
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum and $A=A_{E,n}$ of
[def-pur-conventions]; write $e=e(E/\Ql)$ for the ramification
index of $E/\Ql$ and assume that $e\mid n$. With $v_\ell$ normalized
by $v_\ell(\ell)=1$ (so that $v_\ell(\varpi_E)=1/e$), put

$$
N=n\cdot v_\ell(\varpi_E)\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1},
$$

the smallest exponent with $\ell^N\cdot A=0$; here $N=n/e$, and
$\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E=\ell^N\mathcal O_E$, so that
$A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\cong\mathcal O_E/\ell^N\mathcal O_E\cong (\mathbf Z/\ell^N\mathbf Z)^{ef}$
with $e=e(E/\Ql)$ the ramification index and $f=[\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E:\mathbf F_\ell]$ the residue degree,
is free of finite rank as a $\mathbf Z/\ell^N\mathbf Z$-module. Then there is a canonical isomorphism
of finite-torsion module sheaves on the small pro-etale site of any scheme
$T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible,

$$
A(1)_T\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\mu_{\ell^N,T}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/\ell^N}A,
$$

where $A(1)_T$ is the finite-level twist of
[def-coefficient-twists-detailed], $\mu_{\ell^N,T}$ is the etale sheaf of
$\ell^N$-th roots of unity, and $\otimes$ is over
$\mathbf Z/\ell^N\mathbf Z$. The isomorphism is compatible with the
derived tensor product and with base
change.

proof.text: Use associated powers of the irreducible uniformizer in the chosen DVR to identify ramification, the two power ideals, logarithmic valuations, and the minimal killing exponent. Ideal.quotEquivOfEq gives the normalized quotient equivalence.

Reduce the finite integral basis modulo ell^k by a quotient-Pi equivalence and the p-adic residue homomorphism. The residue field has ell^f elements. The cardinality formula for a prime-power ideal quotient compares its e-step filtration with the basis quotient, giving d=ef. Additive equivalences preserve integer scalars, hence the required ZMod linearity for the unique unital scalar map.

Apply the normalized projection comparison after supplying the proved equality of coefficient ideals. Two scalar-extension/sheafification adjunctions show that the pure-tensor formula uniquely determines the comparison.

Prove composition and identity for maps in the second tensor variable on presheaf pure tensors and sheafify. Tensor with an isomorphism gives an isomorphism in every complex degree, hence a complex isomorphism and quasi-isomorphism. This proves the exact KummerDerivedCompatible predicate without a resolution argument.
Apply the proved normalized base-change square construction to the normalized comparisons.

proof_origin.place: Arithmetic, finite basis, uniqueness, termwise derived compatibility, coordinate root map and conjugated base-change square formalized; two geometric comparisons isolated.
